title: Codex Accounts
subtitle: Manage multiple OpenAI Codex subscription accounts per workspace

addDialog.title: Add Codex account
addDialog.description: Creates a managed account; you'll complete `codex auth login` in an in-browser terminal next.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.description: Clears the account's config_dir and unbinds every workspace referencing it. Refused while a running agent holds the account.

loginDialog.title: Sign in to {{name}}
loginDialog.instruction: Complete the `codex auth login` OAuth flow in the embedded terminal. You can close this dialog once finished.

empty.title: No Codex accounts yet
empty.body: Codex workspaces fall back to the host's ~/.codex/ by default. Click 'Add account' above to let niuniu manage multiple credentials.

defaultRow.name: System default account
defaultRow.description: Unbound Codex workspaces fall back to the host's ~/.codex/. Click 'Sign in' to open a terminal and run `codex login`.

errors.already_authed: Account is already authenticated; to switch credentials, delete and recreate it
